title: Calling all Creators! 📢 Join the CONNECT x Vivienne Westwood 3D Challenge
content:
![e91a0730dbff4289972b39837a75764d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202604/f207f7d99172437485e243629de8712a/images/e91a0730dbff4289972b39837a75764dNewsletter%20Banner%20%281X%29.png)

The wait is finally over! We are incredibly excited to host the global **“CUT, SLASH & CORSET”** design contest right here on **CONNECT**.

This is your chance to show the world what you can do. In collaboration with the iconic **Vivienne Westwood** and powered by **Epic Games’ MetaHuman** , we are inviting **YOU** to bridge the gap between historical heritage and the future of digital fashion.

**Why participate?** This is more than a contest; it is a platform to showcase your skills in digital craftsmanship and storytelling. Whether you are a historical costume enthusiast or a futuristic visionary, we want to see your unique lens on the CLO, Marvelous Designer and MetaHuman universe.

**🏆 THE REWARDS**

  * **1st Place:** $2,000 + a priceless **1:1 Virtual Mentoring & Portfolio Review** with the Vivienne Westwood team.

  * **2nd Place:** $1,000

  * **3rd Place:** $500

  * **Plus:** Winners will be featured across our global social channels!




**🗓️ MARK YOUR CALENDAR**

  * **Submissions Open:** TODAY, April 29

  * **Submissions Close:** June 11

  * **Winners Announced:** June 25




**🚀 GET STARTED** Don’t know where to start? We’ve got you covered:

  1. **Watch:** Our [_Tailoring for MetaHuman_ ](https://www.youtube.com/live/82wkSF1XFx0)webinar to master the workflow.

  2. **Download:** The [_CLO/Marvelous Designer LiveSync Plugin_](https://connect.clo-set.com/livesync) available here on CONNECT.

  3. **Create:** Reimagine the iconic Vivienne Westwood ethos!




**👉**[**VISIT THE CONTEST PAGE FOR FULL DETAILS**](https://connect.clo-set.com/contest/cutslashcorset)

We are so proud of the talent in this community and we cannot wait to see your submissions. Let the digital revolution begin! ✂️⚡️
content_description: Showcase your digital fashion design skills by participating in the global “CUT, SLASH & CORSET” contest, blending Vivienne Westwood’s iconic style with cutting-edge MetaHuman technology.
